They'll teach you our ways - and keep you alive when we get to Alderaan!|A Rally Master speaking to a crowd of new recruits on [[Jebble]]|<ref name="Vector, Part 2">[[Knights of the Old Republic 26|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 26]]</ref>}}
'''Rally Master''', also known as '''Neo-Crusader Rally Master''', was the middle rank of the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusader]] movement during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and a rank in the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter group founded by [[Tor Vizsla]]. Under the Neo-Crusaders, they wore the [[Color/Legends|crimson]] [[Neo-Crusader armor|armor]] and were easily recognized as figures of authority by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] ground forces,<ref name="Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and generic Neo-Crusaders were expected to look for and listen to them.<ref name="Vector, Part 2" />

==History==
===Early history===
During the early days of the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusader]] movement, the Rally Masters worked independently. The position was originally earned by impressing [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshals]], making the position very valuable. Being the closest thing the Mandalorians ever came to officers, they functioned as [[Drill sergeant/Legends|drill sergeants]], [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] and more importantly political officers, spreading the ideals of the Neo-Crusaders amongst the Mandalorian forces. As the Field Marshals increased in numbers, many Rally Masters complained about too much division, as they began to lose their independent command. Rally Masters also oversaw the training of new converts during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], and in training centers on captured worlds they indoctrinated these recruits to the Neo-Crusader way.<ref name="Campaign Guide" />

Later in the Mandalorian Wars, the position became corrupt and the quality of warriors who held the position declined rapidly. The position became increasingly devalued, and to achieve promotion later on a warrior only needed to know [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]] and some of the Mandalorian ways.<ref name="Campaign Guide" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Sith Empire and the Republic, long after the demise of the Neo-Crusader movement, the rank of Rally Master was still present among the Mandalorian forces. In that time, the colors signifying the rank had changed from crimson to a dark gold with silver and blue highlights.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

===Death Watch===
{{Quote|You are reading this because you have been chosen as a Rally Master, charged with training recruits, preparing Watchers for operations and commanding them in battle. Like Cassus Fett's Rally Masters of ancient times, you must educate and inspire our warriors, so they understand their heritage and will sacrifice their lives for it.|Tor Vizsla, ''Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad''|<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
During the intersocietal struggle between the competing ideologies of the traditional [[True Mandalorians]], the pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]], and the radical Death Watch,<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> the position continued to exist among the Death Watch ranks, and were once again represented by crimson color. The training manifesto entitled ''[[Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad]]'', supposedly written by Death Watch [[Secret Mandalore|leader]] Tor Vizsla, was intended for Death Watch Rally Masters, in order to help them train and guide new recruits.<ref name="TBHC" />
